AgentInfo.description_en: The agent configuration information. When you call the API operation, serialize the fields of this structure into JSON. The server routes requests to different processing pipelines, such as text or audio, based on InputType, and routes requests to different instruction processors, such as key property extraction, service quality inspection, or label classification, based on InstructionType
AgentInfo.description_zh: Agent 配置信息。调用接口时，将本结构各字段序列化为 JSON 传入。服务端根据 InputType 路由到不同的处理链路（文本/音频），根据 InstructionType 路由到不同的指令处理器（关键属性抽取/服务质检/标签分类等）

AgentDescription.example: 用于客服会话质量检查的智能体

Id.description_en: The unique identifier of the agent configuration
Id.description_zh: Agent 配置的唯一标识 ID

InputType.description_en: The object type for analysis. Valid values: audio and text
InputType.description_zh: 分析对象类型。取值：audio（语音）、text（文本）

InstructionType.description_en: The instruction type. Valid values: serviceInspection (service quality inspection), field (key property extraction), tagCategory (label classification), multiLevelTag (multi-level label recognition), and customPrompt (custom instruction)
InstructionType.description_zh: 指令类型。取值：serviceInspection（服务质检）、field（关键属性抽取）、tagCategory（标签分类）、multiLevelTag（多级标签识别）、customPrompt（自定义指令）

InstructionTypeParam.description_en: The parameters corresponding to the instruction type. Different InstructionType values require different sub-parameters. Specify only the sub-parameters that correspond to the current InstructionType and leave the others empty
InstructionTypeParam.description_zh: 指令类型对应的参数。不同 InstructionType 需要填写不同的子参数，只需填写与当前 InstructionType 对应的子参数，其余留空

CustomPromptParam.description_en: The custom instruction parameters. Used when InstructionType is set to customPrompt
CustomPromptParam.description_zh: 自定义指令参数（InstructionType = "customPrompt" 时使用）

CustomPrompt.description_en: The content of the user-defined prompt template. This parameter is required
CustomPrompt.description_zh: 用户自定义的 prompt 模板内容（必填）
CustomPrompt.example: 请分析以下对话中客服的服务态度。

NameDescPairList.description_en: The list of name-value pairs attached to the custom instruction
NameDescPairList.description_zh: 自定义指令附带的名称-值对列表

FieldsParam.description_en: The key attribute extraction parameters. Used when InstructionType is set to field
FieldsParam.description_zh: 关键属性抽取参数（InstructionType = "field" 时使用）

NameDescPairList.description_en: The list of attribute dimensions to be extracted
NameDescPairList.description_zh: 需要抽取的属性维度列表

Desc.description_en: The attribute description. This parameter is optional
Desc.example: 客户在会话中提出的具体诉求

Name.description_en: The attribute name. This parameter is required

Value.description_en: The attribute value. In the key attribute extraction scenario, this is the extracted result value corresponding to the dimension
Value.description_zh: 属性值。关键属性抽取场景下，该维度对应的抽取结果值

ServiceInspectionParam.description_en: The service quality inspection parameters. Used when InstructionType is set to serviceInspection
ServiceInspectionParam.description_zh: 服务质检参数（InstructionType = "serviceInspection" 时使用）

Dimensions.description_en: The list of quality inspection dimensions. This parameter is required

Desc.description_en: The dimension description. This parameter is optional

Dimension.description_en: The dimension name. This parameter is required

SceneDescription.description_en: The description of the quality inspection scenario. This parameter is optional
SceneDescription.example: 针对售后客服会话的服务质量检查

SceneName.description_en: The name of the quality inspection scenario. This parameter is required

TagCategoryParam.description_en: The label classification parameters. Used when InstructionType is set to tagCategory
TagCategoryParam.description_zh: 标签分类参数（InstructionType = "tagCategory" 时使用）

NameDescPairList.description_en: The list of label classification dimensions. This parameter is required
NameDescPairList.description_zh: 标签分类维度列表（必填）

Desc.example: 客户咨询问题的类型分类

ValueList.description_en: The list of candidate tag values

TagTreeLevelParam.description_en: The multi-level tag recognition parameters. Used when InstructionType is set to multiLevelTag
TagTreeLevelParam.description_zh: 多级标签识别参数（InstructionType = "multiLevelTag" 时使用）

TagIds.description_en: The list of starting parent tag IDs at runtime. The first ID is treated as the matched parent tag, and recognition proceeds level by level from its child nodes, skipping the preceding levels. This field also takes effect when AgentId is specified
TagIds.description_zh: 运行时起始父标签 ID 列表。取第一个 ID 作为已命中的父标签，从其子节点开始逐级识别（跳过前面层级）。传入 AgentId 时该字段同样生效

TagTreeLevels.description_en: The recognition configuration for each level, arranged in hierarchical order. This parameter is required
TagTreeLevels.description_zh: 每一级的识别配置，按层级顺序排列（必填）

items.description_en: The single-level tag recognition configuration object
items.description_zh: 单层标签识别配置对象

Prompt.description_en: The analysis prompt for this level. It is concatenated with the tag data and sent to the large language model. This parameter is required
Prompt.description_zh: 该层级的分析 prompt，与标签数据拼接后发给大模型（必填）
Prompt.example: 请判断该对话属于哪个标签类别。

TagTreeIds.description_en: The list of candidate tag IDs for this level. A value of -1 indicates that all tags at this level are selected. This parameter is required
TagTreeIds.description_zh: 该层候选标签 ID 列表。包含 -1 表示该层全选（必填）

items.description_en: The candidate tag ID. A value of -1 indicates that all tags at this level are selected
items.description_zh: 候选标签 ID。-1 表示该层全选

ModelType.description_en: The type of the large language model

description_en: Retrieves the details of an agent
name: GetAgent

parameters.help_en: The complete JSON string. For more information, see the following details
parameters.help_zh: 完整JSON字符串信息，具体内容参见以下详细信息
parameters.name: json_str

Code.description_en: The result code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. You can use this field to determine the cause of the failure
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Message.description_en: The error message returned when an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 错误的时候，返回错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
